# WebCatalog

> > WebCatalog transforms websites into native desktop applications for Mac and Windows, enabling seamless multi-account management and enhanced productivity.

WebCatalog is a platform that converts web applications into standalone desktop apps while providing complementary tools like Atlas (speed dial), Singlebox (unified messenger), and Switchbar (browser picker) to enhance the desktop experience. The service supports hundreds of popular web apps including productivity tools, social media, AI assistants, and communication platforms.

## Key Topics

- WebCatalog Desktop
- Mac & Windows support
- Multi-account management
- Desktop apps
- WebCatalog Atlas
- Singlebox Messenger
- Switchbar browser picker
- Cross-platform
- Productivity tools
- AI chatbots
- Social media apps
- Google Workspace integration
- App launcher
- Cloud sync
- Distraction-free browsing

## Core Products

- [WebCatalog Desktop](https://webcatalog.io/en/desktop): Turn websites into native desktop apps for Mac and Windows with enhanced functionality
- [WebCatalog Atlas](https://webcatalog.io/en/atlas): Browser extension with speed dial and cloud-synced new tab page for quick access
- [Singlebox Messenger](https://webcatalog.io/en/singlebox): All-in-one unified messenger and multi-account browser for Mac and PC
- [Switchbar](https://webcatalog.io/en/switchbar): Browser picker and link handler for seamless browser selection on macOS and Windows

## AI & Productivity Apps

- [ChatGPT](https://webcatalog.io/en/apps/chatgpt): ChatGPT desktop app with multi-account support for Mac and Windows
- [Google Gemini](https://webcatalog.io/en/apps/google-bard): Google Gemini AI assistant as a dedicated desktop application
- [Grok](https://webcatalog.io/en/apps/grok): Grok AI assistant desktop app for Mac and Windows
- [Google Calendar](https://webcatalog.io/en/apps/google-calendar): Google Calendar desktop app for enhanced calendar management
- [Google Drive](https://webcatalog.io/en/apps/google-drive): Google Drive desktop app for seamless file storage and access
- [Gmail](https://webcatalog.io/en/apps/gmail): Gmail desktop app for Mac and Windows with multi-account capabilities

## Communication & Social Media Apps

- [WhatsApp](https://webcatalog.io/en/apps/whatsapp): WhatsApp desktop app for Mac and Windows with full messaging support
- [Google Voice](https://webcatalog.io/en/apps/google-voice): Google Voice desktop app for calling and messaging on Mac/Windows
- [X (Twitter)](https://webcatalog.io/en/apps/twitter): X desktop app for Mac and Windows with enhanced social browsing
- [Facebook](https://webcatalog.io/en/apps/facebook): Facebook desktop app for Mac and Windows
- [Instagram](https://webcatalog.io/en/apps/instagram): Instagram desktop app for Mac and Windows
- [TikTok](https://webcatalog.io/en/apps/tiktok): TikTok desktop app for Mac and Windows

## Entertainment & Shopping Apps

- [YouTube](https://webcatalog.io/en/apps/youtube): YouTube desktop app for Mac and Windows with native app experience
- [Amazon Shopping](https://webcatalog.io/en/apps/amazon): Amazon Shopping desktop app for Mac and Windows
